original.subject: Millbrook — Orchard Standpipe
original.body:
Marcus,

The Tier 1 consultation is recorded as of 08:40. Please send the advisory text, the street boundaries and your sampling plan.

For lifting: the cause corrected, residual at least 0.5 mg/L throughout the area, and two consecutive rounds of satisfactory bacteriological samples 24 hours apart. For a chemical event, results below the health-based level at every sample point.

Call the 24-hour line if anything changes.

Paul Grieve
District Engineer, Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District

fields.note: This is the official submission of the tampering incident at Orchard Standpipe via the Ohio EPA DDAGW web portal (portal.ddagw.ohio.gov/erpsubmit). original.subject: Formal Report Submission — Tampering at Orchard Standpipe
original.body:
To: Ohio EPA DDAGW (District Engineer Paul Grieve)

Subject: Formal Report — Tampering at Orchard Standpipe (Report ID: DDAGW-ER-2025-0720-001)

This report confirms the verified malevolent act at the Orchard Standpipe facility on October 24, 2026. The incident was detected via sustained drift in outlet chlorine residual AIT-611 to 0.7 mg/L, confirmed by manual lab sampling (LAB-002-2025.pdf). Field verification confirmed physical intrusion via forced gate (ZS-612) and cut padlock on ladder cage access. The hatch switch ZS-611 remained inactive, but its status was not updated in the system since July 2024 (per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3). The site is secured, the advisory remains in effect for Zone 2, and all forensic evidence has been preserved per FBI directive (FBI-ORD-2025-0720-001.pdf).

All supporting data has been uploaded to the portal:
- LAB-002-2025.pdf: Lab report from manual grab sample (03:45 AM)
- ORCH-001_Photo_1.jpg: Photo of cut padlock and ajar ladder cage door
- RTU-02_EventLog_072025.csv: Full event log from 02:00 to 05:00, showing gate trips at 02:15 and 04:30

This event qualifies as a Tier 1 public-notice situation under ERP Section 9.2. Request for formal investigation and compliance follow-up per C6 and Section 5.3 of the ERP. All actions taken to date are documented in the incident log.

Respectfully,

Marcus Oyelaran
Water Quality Manager
City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
(555) 037-1555 (Ohio EPA DDAGW line)
marcus.oyelaran@millbrook-oh.example

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the regulatory reporting step is complete. The WQ role must acknowledge, and IC/PIO must track the formal submission as a milestone. Watch for any attempt to bypass the formal process.
